feedback_assessment.synchronization: Relevant: explicit device-to-host copies, tensor-to-Python scalar conversions, and tensor-dependent Python branches occur in the hot loop. Their share of runtime has not been profiled.
feedback_assessment.force_spikes: Plausible numerical sensitivity, not established artificiality. The budget uses incoming wrist-joint load; fixture contact tensors are a different measurement. High load can include gravity, inertia and real collision impulses. Raw-aborted traces are censored and cannot prove a filtered controller would safely continue.
feedback_assessment.narrative: Accepted: empirical recovery reliability, costs and limitations. Adaptive allocation is a tested hypothesis, not an algorithmic novelty claim.

observed_performance.caveat: Different workloads and cohort sizes. These are not a measured optimization comparison or sustained PPO capacity. Matrix counts exclude initialization stepping.

hotspots.finding: Every physics sample converts velocity error and tensor finite checks to host scalars, transfers fixture/finger/state tensors to lists, then runs per-job Python median/history logic and per-job GPU hold assignments.
Actor observations, actions, pose traces and every reward term move to CPU each control step; actor retries run per environment in Python.
Reward reconstruction float(max) and tensor-dependent success-latch/logging branches synchronize at control endpoints.

tensorized_training_design.ownership: Add a separate project-owned fast training adapter; keep PegStudyEnv and saved JSON replay as the reference evaluator. Do not modify .deps/IsaacLab.
tensorized_training_design.physics_kernel: Store outcome, terminal step, dwell, contact/grasp grace, progress state, force peaks, contact witnesses and active masks as fixed-size CUDA tensors. Apply failure precedence and hold-target latches with tensor masks/where; no item(), cpu(), tolist(), nonzero-dependent host control or per-env Python loop in steady state.
tensorized_training_design.exact_progress_semantics: Use ring buffers for 1 s load/down occupancies and 0.1 s height filter. For even windows reproduce statistics.median by averaging both middle sorted values; torch.median alone chooses the lower middle. Preserve anti-oscillation best-depth logic and consecutive-physics-step accounting.
tensorized_training_design.actor_path: Keep policy observations and actions on CUDA; implement the bounded retry with tensor phase/state buffers if used as a training comparator. Preserve noisy target frame, clamps, synthetic-noise timing and current actor-only information limits.
tensorized_training_design.reward_path: Cache invariant device constants, use a device boolean for the existing cohort success latch, and tensorize all reward terms without changing their formula or resolved zero action-change coefficient. Disable per-term CPU trace/log work in training; compare every term against reference on a small dev cohort.
tensorized_training_design.terminal_path: Finite 30 s full-cohort jobs with absorbing hold slots after early termination. Emit terminal done once; zero post-terminal reward/bootstrap, mask absorbing entries in PPO/RNN/normalization updates, count their transitions. Active jobs may bootstrap across PPO rollout chunks, never across job terminals. Full-cohort resets only between jobs.
tensorized_training_design.partial_reward_candidate: Before freeze, implement and test a pure reward sample at the terminal physics state, weighted by elapsed fraction k/decimation of the final control interval; retain zero bootstrap. Treat this as a shared reward-accounting correction and rerun both matched arms, preserving the current endpoint-omission ledger. Cohort latch update ordering must be explicit.
tensorized_training_design.logging: Keep aggregated counters on device; bounded audit buffers for a small fixed dev subset. Export at cohort/rollout boundaries through pinned buffers, not per physics step. PhysX still has a CPU driver; fully tensorized here means batched project bookkeeping, not a promise of zero engine synchronization.
tensorized_training_design.memory: Preallocate ring buffers and rollout storage; no cameras/video/full JSON histories in training. Start 32/64 environments, then test 128 only with measured total GPU use below 10 GiB on the 12 GiB device, leaving roughly 2 GiB headroom. Include renderer/PhysX and recurrent actor+critic memory, not just torch allocator counters.
tensorized_training_design.benchmark: Same seeds, random/policy actions, precision, geometry, solver and force criteria. Profile warmup then steady-state CUDA kernels, host gaps, device copies and Isaac/PhysX steps; compare traced reference, trace-disabled reference and tensorized adapter. One serial queue. Once gates pass, measure at least 20 PPO epochs and optimizer peak memory before campaign sizing.
tensorized_training_design.acceptance: Replay identical saved traces through CPU and GPU evaluator; match outcomes, terminal steps, force/grasp precedence, stalls and dwell exactly and reward terms within declared FP tolerance. Run bounded online dev pairing and instantiated actor/critic leak tests before accepting any throughput claim. Count all probe/mining/initialization costs.

force_diagnostic_design.status: CPU reference and synthetic controls; no job-abort behavior change
force_diagnostic_design.signal: Nonnegative magnitude of raw incoming wrist-joint force, separate from fixture normal contact.
force_diagnostic_design.formula: fbar_t = exp(-dt/0.020)*fbar_previous + (1-exp(-dt/0.020))*norm(F_t); initialize from the first real sample. Label sustained overload when fbar >20 N continuously for >=0.025 s.
force_diagnostic_design.raw_accounting: Always retain raw >20 N violation, native-step peak, and integral max(norm(F)-20,0)*dt. Filtered overload is not a contact-jam witness; require separate contact and lack-of-progress evidence.
force_diagnostic_design.abort_policy: Keep current raw 20 N job abort. Replacing it by the filtered trigger allows transient loads above 20 N and changes the task; do not relabel existing aborts or adopt that rule without measured development controls and a shared protocol correction.
required_controls: Synthetic pulse versus sustained plateau and timestep-invariant time constants (CPU tests).
Development timestep refinement and solver/contact-convergence probes under identical commands, with raw wrist/fixture traces and positive contact controls.
Determine whether suspected impulses converge in integrated load and physical motion. Do not infer post-abort recovery from counterfactual actions or hold-period samples.

If a filtered-abort criterion is later justified, declare any separate peak guard from measured development support and rerun both arms before freezing; no arbitrary larger ceiling or hardware-safety claim.

selected_final_test.question: Does complete-job reliability and witnessed recovery survive physics timestep refinement without policy retraining?
selected_final_test.design: Evaluate the same frozen checkpoints and preselected case parameters at physics dt 1/120 and 1/240 s; retain 15 Hz policy actions, the same geometry, observation interface, reward, force criteria and 30 s deadline.
selected_final_test.checkpoint_selection: Final predeclared training-transition target common to all arms; never final-test performance.
selected_final_test.selection_rule: Before opening final results, choose the first 48 fault and 16 nominal case IDs in a deterministic seed-balanced, bin-balanced round-robin from the frozen main final-test manifest. Use identical IDs for every arm/checkpoint. No selection based on stalls, successful recovery, forces, or method scores.
control_and_sensor_invariants: Preserve 15 Hz action timing and 120 Hz servo/observation-noise update timing; hold torques and noise between the two finer physics substeps. Increasing servo update rate would confound numerical refinement with a controller change.

Preserve physical-time force-filter constants, dwell, stall windows and abort latency. Record raw forces at both native 120/240 Hz and a common 120 Hz comparison grid; never hide native peak violations.
Use separate deterministic RNG streams for fault/nuisance settings and sensor noise so extra physics steps do not consume different random draws.

Use the same declared valid initialization procedure and sampled parameters, not an incomplete restored PhysX snapshot. Report realized pose/grasp differences caused by refinement; include invalid initializations as failed requests.
selected_final_test.primary_addition_endpoint: Joint completion across resolutions: mean(S_120 * S_240) over every preselected request. Both successes must satisfy dwell, retained grasp, time and force criteria.
supporting_readouts: Completion difference between resolutions by arm and training seed; paired uncertainty over case IDs and between-seed variation.
Witnessed contact-failure/recovery/prevention labels separately at each resolution, without selecting a method-specific denominator.
Raw peak load, excess-force impulse, sustained-load diagnostic and failure/abort counts; raw spikes are not assumed to be numerical artifacts.
selected_final_test.primary_study_endpoint_unchanged: Main held-out unfinished jobs per 100 requests at equal training cost.
selected_final_test.cost_note: Coarse cases are reused from main final evaluation; finer runs add 64 cases x 3 training seeds x 3 arms x 2 tasks. Count initialization, probes, failures and all extra evaluation costs; one GPU job. No additional policy training.
selected_final_test.required_development_gate: Verify timestep conversion, force units, control/noise timing, initial validity and synthetic/refined contact controls before opening final tests. No backend upgrade, geometry change or sensor-history assumption from newer Isaac Lab versions.
selected_final_test.novelty_scope: A distinctive empirical stress test for this study; no claim that timestep refinement or this endpoint is new to the literature.
